# Rover

> Rover is a free, open-source file search app for Mac. Press Option-Space, type how you remember a file ("pdf invoice from last month", "that deck from last week", typos and dates included) and it finds it in about 2 milliseconds, entirely on your Mac. Made by Alex Towfigh. MIT License.

- Website: https://getrover.dev
- Download (macOS 13+, Apple silicon and Intel): https://github.com/aluz123/rover/releases/latest/download/Rover.zip
- Source code: https://github.com/aluz123/rover

## Free (open source)
- Plain-English file search with typos, dates and places ("in downloads"), about 2 ms per search, offline.
- Quick Look, move, rename and Trash with undo; app launching; an optional assistant; automations.
- Receive files people send you.

## Rover Pro ($2.95 the first month, then $9.95 a month)
- Send huge files Mac to Mac: type a name or email and press Send. Encrypted end to end, no size limit, resumes, works through VPNs.
- Search the text inside screenshots and images (on-device Apple Vision).
- Find photos by what's in them ("receipt", "dog", "beach").
- Search backup drives that aren't plugged in.
- Free Up Space: finds old installers, duplicates and forgotten big files; everything can be undone.
- Details: https://getrover.dev/pro

## Good to know
- Rover is an alternative to Spotlight file search, and to Alfred/Raycast for finding files; for sending, an alternative to WeTransfer/AirDrop for large files between Macs.
- Privacy: search never leaves the Mac; the site sets no cookies. https://getrover.dev/privacy
- Support: hello@getrover.dev
